name: GB Logistics Commerce Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, GB Logistics Commerce Limited is engaged in the Logistics business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GB Logistics Commerce Limited operates in two main verticals:
1. Logistics: Provides full-truckload freight services across the country. The offerings include full truckload (FTL) transportation, special handling, godown-to-godown transportation, above-ground-floor delivery, and out-of-delivery area (ODA) shipments. The company utilizes both proprietary and third-party transportation services for its logistics operations.
2. Trading: Engages in trading of agricultural commodities, capitalizing on incidental opportunities arising from its logistics activities.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.82 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 235 days.
